place.name: Redcliffe Plantation State Historic Site
place.description: Redcliffe Plantation State Historic Site is a state park in rural Aiken County, South Carolina, United States. The state park includes: 369 acres of land Redcliffe Plantation, which is a historic house museum with artifacts from four generations of the Hammond family from 1859-1975 Two historic circa 1857 slave cabins that interpret the lives of the approximately 300 people Hammond enslaved across his plantations The site is part of the Reconstruction Era National Historic Network.
